items.title: Holman Bill — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He showed me quite a bit about saxophone playing.

ctx.x: How did you get in the band?

A friend of mine, Dick Meldonian, who later got me on the Kenton band, got me on Charlie‟s band. He was the lead alto player. He showed me quite a bit about saxophone playing. Although he was a few years younger than I, he‟d studied with a real good teacher. I don‟t know where he was from. The guy that also taught Joe Maini and Paul Gonsalves. What‟s the big town in Rhode Island?
